packetbeat/protos/dhcpv4: fix panic on short OptionTimeOffset value (#53419) (#53497)

A malformed DHCP packet with an OptionTimeOffset value shorter than
4 bytes caused binary.BigEndian.Uint32 to panic with an index out of
range error, allowing a remote peer to crash the Packetbeat DHCP
parser path.

Guard the decode with a length check and skip the field silently if
the value is not exactly 4 bytes. Apply the same skip-on-error
pattern to OptionTimeServer so a malformed value there does not abort
parsing of all subsequent options.

(cherry picked from commit cb3199cd4174e10c1ee5e624f9671b1ce07cb1f4)

Co-authored-by: Dan Kortschak <dan.kortschak@elastic.co>
